verdict.rationale: The evidence only hints at this story. Activepieces has a concept of authentication/connections to other services (comm-5), audit logs record the account an agent used (docs-10), and governance messaging says admins 'decide who can build, what they can reach' (docs-44). None of this explicitly documents a central credential store, team sharing, or per-credential permissions. Missing for 10: documented centralized connection/credential storage, sharing of connections across team or projects, per-credential access controls or RBAC, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
